mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_file (title, category, author, status, view_count, file_type, file_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size) VALUES (#{title}, #{category}, #{author}, #{status}, #{viewCount}, #{fileType}, #{fileName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_file SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
